name: Blue Manuscript
summary: A golden manuscript medallion becomes a confident, compact identity for Quran and remembrance.
why: A broad eight-point medallion recalls ornamental verse markers and illuminated manuscript margins. Its open diamond and ivory center simplify that tradition into a bold mark, with deep blue and gold giving the app an unmistakable editorial character.
risk: It emphasizes Quran and devotional reading more than prayer schedules, and can also resemble a cultural institution's emblem.
